subject: SET statement
notes: kb/Work PB453 - Format 17's NULL general rule, under the same decline as GR-14.9.39.4-40. GR41 - "If NULL is specified, the content of data-name-5 shall be set to that of the null value" (cite.py --check 14.9.39.4 OK). Its own witness is the TO NULL statement in negative/pb453-set-message-tag-format17, which is the arm that used to draw Format 5's SR8 diagnostic: `SET MT1 TO NULL` reaches the format selection through setObjectReferenceStatement rather than setToValueStatement, so a fix that answered only the second arm would have left this rule's exact spelling still mis-diagnosed (feedback_two_arm_dispatch). The null value here is 8.4.3.10.4's implementor-defined value guaranteed not to represent a message server or requestor - distinct from the data-pointer NULL - and is unimplemented with GR40 under the same owner determination.
